 Order

This is the first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to F.I.R. No.99 of 2024 dated 22.04.2024 registered at Police Station Develond,
District Shahdol for the offence under Sections 376, 294, 506 of IPC.
The applicant is in custody since 23.04.2024.

As per the prosecution case, on 18.04.2024 at about 10 PM in the night, when prosecutrix was going to attend a marriage function with her brother in- law, at that time present applicant came there and committed rape with her.
The applicant also threatened the prosecutrix of dire consequences.

Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the alleged incident has took place on 18.04.2024,
while the FIR has been lodged on 21.04.2024.
There is a delay in lodging the FIR but no explanation of delay in lodging the FIR has been mentioned.
No internal or external injury has been found on the person of the prosecutrix.

The statement under Section 161 of Cr.P.C. of prosecutrix has 2 MCRC-28843-2024 been recorded in which she supported the case of the prosecution but in the statement recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C., she has nothing stated in her statement against the applicant.
Applicant has falsely been implicated in the crime.
He has not committed any offence in any manner.
Charge sheet in the matter has been filed.
The applicant is in custody since 23.04.2024.
There is no further requirement of custodial interrogation of the applicant.
He is ready to abide by all the terms and conditions that may be imposed by this Court while considering his application for grant of bail.
On these grounds, he has prayed for grant of bail to the applicant.

sentences.text: Per contra, State counsel has vehemently opposed the application.

In view of the delay in lodging the FIR, MLC and the statement of prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. but without commenting upon the merits of the case, this Court deems it appropriate to allow this application.
Accordingly, the application is allowed.
He is directed to be released on bail on furnishing surety bond of Rs.30,000/-(Rupees Thirty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court.
It is also directed that the applicant shall comply with the conditions as enumerated under Section 437(3) Cr.P.C.

This order shall remain effective till the end of the trial but in case of bail jump and breach of any of the pre-condition of bail, it shall become ineffective and cancelled without reference to this Bench.
Application stands allowed.
Certified copy as per rules.
